name: Macquarie University Higher Study Scholarship
summary: Yearly payment for postgraduate coursework or Honours students in financial hardship with academic excellence.
who: Australian citizen or permanent resident (including permanent humanitarian visa)
Postgraduate coursework or Honours degree (not Graduate Certificate or Diploma)
how: Apply via the UAC Equity Scholarship Application Portal
catches: The page still shows 2024 round dates; check UAC for the current round

source.label: Macquarie University: Higher Study Scholarship (full-time rate)

evidence.quote: Applicants need to be in receipt of Youth Allowance or any other means tested Commonwealth support payment.
